The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1921–1922''' was contested by 43 teams participating in four divisions. The national champion would be determined by a play-off featuring the winners of the eastern, northern, southern and western football division of the [[Netherlands]]. [[Go Ahead Eagles|Go Ahead]] won this year's championship by beating [[Blauw-Wit Amsterdam]], [[NAC Breda|NAC]], and [[Be Quick 1887]].

==New entrants==
'''Eerste Klasse East:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[Heracles Almelo|Heracles]]

'''Eerste Klasse North:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[Upright (football club)|Upright]]

'''Eerste Klasse South:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[PSV Eindhoven]]

'''Eerste Klasse West:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[Feyenoord|Feijenoord]] (returning after two seasons of absence) & [[RCH (football club)|RCH]]
